name: step_ap203_says_so
why: THE SAME PART WITH THE OTHER PROTOCOL, and the file declares it differently. It is the red of the line that re-reads the FILE_SCHEMA: if the preference `swStepAP` did nothing -- or if the number were the wrong one -- this case and the AP214 one would come out identical, and both green. Two different protocols that are written differently are the only proof that the preference reaches its destination.
_why_ap203_is_also_needed: some suppliers accept ONLY the 203. Sending a 214 to someone who reads only the 203 means a file that does not open, and it is discovered on the other side.

expect.why: it is the HALF THAT COUNTS: it is not enough that the right name is there, the name of the other protocol must not be
